crop.notes: Includes the unrelated 'An Unprofitable Contest' walking-match item above; 'The Ring: Tom Allen Challenges John Sullivan' below is the Allen item and is complete

ocr.notes: 'JOBN IVAN' is John Sullivan, '$1,' is $1,000, Allen's name garbled ('Alep'), the stakes and New Orleans line missing

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Richard K. Fox deposited $1,000 with Harry Hill to back Tom Allen against John L. Sullivan for the world championship within 100 miles of New Orleans.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Tuesday Morning, October 31, 1882, page 4. Duplicate of 655.

facts.fact: Richard K. Fox deposited $1,000 with Harry Hill and challenged on Allen's behalf any pugilist, John L. Sullivan preferred, for the championship of the world, $1,000 to $2,500 a side, within 100 miles of New Orleans within three months of signing articles

notes: Same item and page as 655 but a fuller crop; this one is the better copy to keep.
